config.clickLoad: Click "Load Config" to read the current device configuration.
config.noResponseWarning: No response from device. If using an emonTx4/5, the serial jumper must be removed for commands to work. See documentation for details.
config.firmwareUpdateMessage: Looks like you are running an older firmware version. Please upgrade the device firmware to use this tool.
config.flashFirmwareDesc: Flash via emonWifi (takes ~2 min, do not power off)
config.firmwareDirectUrlOverride: Version selector disabled — direct URL will be used
config.flashServiceMissingNote: The emontx_updater component is not loaded on this ESPHome device. Add emontx_updater (and http_request) to your ESPHome configuration and reflash the device via USB to enable OTA firmware updates.
config.uartBootloaderNote: OTA flashing requires the UART SAM-BA bootloader. If this is your first OTA flash, connect the device via USB, copy change-bootloader-uart.uf2 from the emon32-fw release onto the EMONBOOT drive, then eject. This only needs to be done once.
config.uartBootloaderDocLink: Step-by-step instructions: Changing the bootloader (OpenEnergyMonitor docs)
config.uartBootloaderReady: UART bootloader detected — device is ready for OTA firmware updates.
config.uartBootloaderUnknownNote: This firmware does not report the bootloader type. You can still attempt OTA flashing — if the UART bootloader is not installed, the flash will fail safely without touching the device.
config.switchToUsbBootloaderDesc: Reverts device to UF2/USB bootloader — OTA flashing will no longer be available.
config.switchToUsbConfirmNote: This will flash the USB/UF2 bootloader to the device. After this, OTA firmware updates will not work until you re-apply the UART bootloader via USB. The device will reboot automatically.
config.serialDescOff: No serial output. Datalog interval and JSON format have no effect.
config.serialDescNormal: Outputs message counter, voltages, power and energy for up to 12 channels.
config.serialDescVerbose: Normal output plus current, power factor and apparent power per channel.
config.tempSensorsDesc: DS18B20 OneWire temperature sensors connected to OPA channels configured as OneWire.
config.noTempSensors: No temperature sensors found. Click "Scan Sensors" to search for connected DS18B20 sensors.
config.tempSlotsHelp: Drag sensors between slots or use the dropdown to reassign. Click "Save Mapping" to persist changes.
config.modifiedHint: Applied - Save to Flash to persist
config.unsavedMappingWarning: Click "Save Mapping" to save sensor assignments to device memory.
config.newSensorsWarning: Click "Save Mapping" to save sensor assignments to device memory.
config.missingSensorsWarning: Saved sensors are not detected on the bus. Check connections or clear the slots.

autoCalibration.title: Automatic Calibration
autoCalibration.description: Calibrate the voltage of each phase or multiple CTs with a known reference. The firmware saves each successful calibration automatically.
autoCalibration.currentHelp: Place all selected CTs around the same conductor carrying a stable known load.
autoCalibration.voltageHelp: Connect all selected voltage inputs to the same source and use the voltage measured by an official meter or MID device.
autoCalibration.warning: Calibration can take up to one minute per channel. Keep the load or voltage stable until the operation completes.
